title: Hedgehog
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- hedgehog body/spines as a rounded dome -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='34' ry='26' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <!-- spine texture: lighter spikes on the dome -->
  <g fill='#c58b48'>
    <polygon points='22,52 26,34 32,50'/>
    <polygon points='34,46 40,26 46,44'/>
    <polygon points='48,44 54,24 60,44'/>
    <polygon points='62,46 68,28 74,48'/>
    <polygon points='28,62 20,48 34,58'/>
    <polygon points='70,60 80,46 76,62'/>
  </g>
  <!-- belly / lighter underside -->
  <path d='M18 62 Q50 88 82 62 Q50 74 18 62 Z' fill='#e8c48a'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='18' ry='13' fill='#f0d3a0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='63' r='3.2' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='63' r='3.2' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='62' r='1.1' fill='#fff2d8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='62' r='1.1' fill='#fff2d8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='71' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#40231a'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='70' r='1' fill='#c88'/>
  <!-- little smile -->
  <path d='M46 75 Q50 78 54 75' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='69' r='2.5' fill='#f0a48c'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='69' r='2.5' fill='#f0a48c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='54' r='4' fill='#c58b48'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='54' r='4' fill='#c58b48'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='84' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#e8c48a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='84' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#e8c48a'/>
</svg>
